question: How incomplete were the industry groups that yeslab_357 and yeslab_471 were computed on?

code_basis.yeslab_357: base.py:112-118 industry_zscore_and_skew -- valid = values.notna() & groups.notna(); the group mean and std are transformed over `valid` only
code_basis.yeslab_471: AttentionSpilloverCalculator._calculate -- row_df.dropna(subset=['attention','mv','industry']) before groupby('industry') and market-cap tercile bucketing
code_basis.consequence: a security with no label is excluded from its industry's statistics, so every OTHER member of that industry is measured against an incomplete group

what_this_does_not_say: This sizes the INCIDENCE -- how much of each group was missing -- not the MAGNITUDE of the resulting change in any security's factor value. Magnitude needs a replay, which is the owner-gated next step and was not run here.
